posts.name: MarioFanaticXV
posts.cooked:
Hero cards can't come into play for any reason. So avoid any environments that can play hero cards for you (EG Atlantis or Realm of Discord).

Dark Watch Mr. Fixer is awesome for this acheivement, though no matter what you do, you're going to have to get lucky.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
On the Steam forum UXM266 posted steps which work well:

- Omnitron-X

- Dark Visionary

- Grandpa Legacy

vs 

Gloomweaver in the Final Wasteland

1. Use Omnitron-X's power on Gloomweaver to trash relics or anything really

2. Use Dark Visionary to stack his deck

3.  Use Grandpa Legacy power on either

4.  Let Unforgiving Wasteland deal with any villain targets

5.  Win by relic victory

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
I had to try this twice--I think there's a bug in the current version of the game.  First I beat Ambuscade the old-fashioned way: Legacy, Fanatic, Dark Watch Fixer, Tempest, and Dark Visionary in Final Wasteland.  I won, without any hero cards coming into play, but no achievement.  Might be because I suspended the game and came back to it later.

Second try, I did the Gloomweaver thing and won at the end of round 2, and got the achievement.  The relics were 3 of the top 4 cards in the deck!
